svg.font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The three things that actually kill a web design company
svg.desc: Cash: design work is delivered before it is paid, so a company can be profitable on paper and dead in the bank on the same Tuesday. Concentration: one client at 60 percent of revenue is an employer who can fire you without notice or severance. Dependence: leads, portfolio and client relationships should not live inside a platform that can change its rules.
svg.text: Design work is delivered before it is paid.Profitable on paper and dead in the bankon the same Tuesday.
One client at 60% of revenue is not aclient. It is an employer who can fire youwithout notice or severance.
Your leads, portfolio and client relationsshould not live inside a platform thatcan change its rules on a Tuesday.
None of the three is a design problem.Kerning has never killed a studio.
